I'll start by reading TASK.md and brief.md so I can follow the brief exactly, including Section 0.Section 0 points at the T3j and T5 rules plus the background docs. I'll read those next so the measurements and routing stay inside those constraints.The stock screen and the Z5 RAM map are the two measurements the rest of the work depends on. I'll record both before changing anything.The stock screen is opened from the shooting keys and from the AF Target Settings page. I'll scan free RAM in the Z5 overlay and boot a stock session to record what that screen actually reads and writes.The direct screen is the arrow-pad editor. Zone, size, and position go through the mapped setter with the value in A1. I'll redirect those accessors onto a free block beside the profile and test that path.The redirect works: C1 and Small are on the profile, and the half-press cells stay put. Next I’ll see whether the direct screen can change a custom size, then run acceptance.The custom preset is applied when C1 is selected, and MENU leaves that edit in place. I’ll run the acceptance against those measured values.The acceptance matched the stock control on a normal edit, and the AF-ON confirm left the half-press cells alone. MENU does not restore the profile. I’ll write that up with the layout and the native hook sites.The stock AF target screen now reads and writes the AF-ON profile while it is in AF-ON mode, and a normal edit still changes only the half-press cells.

The direct screen is the arrow-pad screen (`ID_ST_MENU_DIRECT`). It writes the change index, not the saved index. The combined emulator-only hook is the cell getter `0x60063380` and the cell setter `0x60063431`, gated by the session flag at `0xa031e91f`. The zone byte stays at `0xa031e920`. The mirror is 55 bytes at `0xa031eeb0`. No image byte was added. The overlay is the Z5 set of 3262 rows, and the only section 6 or 7 bytes are the three inherited call-site bytes.

Acceptance in `work/out/accept-e3.jsonl`:

- Confirm passed. Moving the target, changing type, and selecting C1 (current size 4×6) landed in the profile. The half-press cells stayed at the blank-session values.
- A normal edit matched the stock control, and the profile stayed at its default.
- The native stores matched both a stock session and a Z5 session that never opened the editor. A new session reads the zone byte as 0.
- Cancel failed, and that failure was kept. MENU leaves the edited profile in place. The stock screen does the same with the half-press change indices, so the run ends `ok: false` on that step.

The emulator did not supply a second orientation: `0xe91` index 3 stayed 0 after rotate and after closing the monitor. INFO does not write the custom preset slots. The screen copies those slots into the current size.

`work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json` are in place. The entry options for Q5 are in `work/out/design.md`.The stock-screen measurements and the accessor disassembly both finished cleanly and are already in the report.

The arrow keys open the direct AF target screen. The main dial changes the zone type and the current size, and the arrows move the target. OK leaves those change-index values in place, and MENU does not restore them. The listings for the cell getter and setter match the stock image.

That is the behaviour the AF-ON hook follows. Confirm, the normal edit, and the native save all passed. The cancel step failed because MENU keeps the edited profile, and that failure is recorded in `work/result.md`.
